title: CLI & Onboarding
lead: The human entry point: init, mine, search, wake-up, run, status.
summary: MemPalace's CLI (cli.py) dispatches 14 primary commands — init (setup + corpus detection), mine (three ingestion modes), search, wake-up (L0+L1 context injection), status, repair, and maintenance tooling — while onboarding.py guides first-time users through mode selection (work/personal/combo), entity registration, and embedding-model choice, seeding the entity registry and critical-facts bootstrap before mining begins.

concepts.definition: Corpus-origin detection run during init to classify whether a corpus is AI-dialogue (Claude, ChatGPT, Slack exports), using a two-tier system: Tier 1 regex heuristics (always runs, no API) + Tier 2 optional LLM refinement for platform/persona extraction.
L0 (identity from ~/.mempalace/identity.txt) + L1 (top 15 importance-scored drawers) injected into agent startup; ~600–900 tokens of critical facts without burning full context window.
Onboarding asks user to pick between embeddinggemma (multilingual, 300 MB, default) or minilm (English-only, 30 MB); choice persists in config.json so future runs skip the prompt.

Projects (code/docs), Convos (chat exports with optional auto-classification), and Extract (binary office documents); each mode feeds a specialized miner with different chunking and metadata strategies.
Compressed notation (entity codes, emotion markers, pipe-separated fields) for efficient memory storage that remains readable to humans and LLMs; generated on init as aaak_entities.md.
Wings (top-level: projects or people), Rooms (topics/domains), Closets (summaries), Drawers (verbatim memories); Halls connect rooms within wings, Tunnels connect rooms across wings.
JSON-based stdin/stdout system (session-start, stop, precompact) for auto-save every 15 human messages or before context compaction; integrates with Claude Code and Codex harnesses.
mempalace init produces the same output on re-run by filtering out mempalace's own artifacts (entities.json, mempalace.yaml) from corpus-origin samples so detection doesn't drift.

symbols.name: cmd_init
symbols.role: Entry point for mempalace init; orchestrates four-pass setup (corpus detection, entity discovery, room detection, gitignore protection, optional post-init mine).

symbols.name: _run_pass_zero
symbols.role: Corpus-origin detection (Tier 1 heuristic + optional Tier 2 LLM); writes origin.json with platform/persona detection for downstream entity classification.

symbols.name: _maybe_run_mine_after_init
symbols.role: Post-init mine prompt and execution; shows file count/size estimate before asking user; reuses pre-scan result to avoid redundant tree walk.

symbols.name: cmd_mine
symbols.role: Dispatcher for three mining modes (projects, convos, extract) with --wing, --dry-run, --include-ignored, --max-chunks-per-file controls; catches MineAlreadyRunning and MineValidationError.

symbols.name: cmd_wakeup
symbols.role: CLI entry for wake-up context (L0+L1); instantiates MemoryStack and calls stack.wake_up(wing=args.wing) to inject ~600–900 tokens into agent startup.

symbols.name: run_onboarding
symbols.role: Interactive first-run setup; prompts for mode (work/personal/combo), embedding model, people, projects, wings; generates AAAK bootstrap and critical-facts files.

symbols.name: MemoryStack
symbols.role: Unified interface to 4-layer memory stack; wake_up() concatenates L0 (identity) + L1 (top drawers); recall(wing) retrieves L2 on-demand; search(query) performs L3 semantic search.

symbols.name: Layer1.generate
symbols.role: Fetches top 15 importance-scored drawers from ChromaDB, groups by room, truncates to MAX_CHARS=3200 (~800 tokens) to fit within wake-up budget.

symbols.name: _ask_embedding_model
symbols.role: Prompts user for embedding model (embeddinggemma multilingual default vs. minilm English-only); choice persists in config.json via set_embedding_model.

symbols.name: run_instructions
symbols.role: Reads and prints instruction markdown files (init, search, mine, help, status) from instructions/ directory; consumed by skill harness for agent routing.

symbols.name: PALACE_PROTOCOL
symbols.role: Protocol string included in MCP status response; instructs agents to call mempalace_status on wake-up, verify facts before responding, and write diary after sessions.

symbols.name: AAAK_SPEC
symbols.role: Dialect specification (3-letter codes, emotion markers, pipe-separated fields) included in status response; teaches agents the compressed notation used for memory storage.

surprises.title: Heuristic truth wins over weak LLM
surprises.detail: Tier 2 LLM can extract persona names and platform, but its likely_ai_dialogue answer is DISCARDED if it differs from confident Tier 1 heuristic (line 145). This design (PR #1211 review) protects against weak local models (e.g. Ollama gemma4:e4b) flipping confident regex answers. The LLM is a scalpel, not a hammer.

surprises.title: Init re-run is NOT idempotent by default, but made so via filtering
surprises.detail: Without the artifact-skip logic (line 74–81), re-running init would pick up the entities.json and mempalace.yaml it wrote on the first run, changing corpus-origin density and producing a different classification. The filter makes it idempotent — a non-obvious but critical detail for multi-user teams or CI systems.

surprises.title: Corpus-origin evidence is immutable once prefixed
surprises.detail: When _run_pass_zero detects that evidence lines are already prefixed ('Tier-1 heuristic: '), it skips re-prefixing (line 158–167). This allows origin.json to be read multiple times without duplicating prefixes, but also means once written, evidence trails are frozen. Re-running --redetect-origin on mine (line 498) only runs Tier 1 heuristics (no LLM), so evidence cannot be upgraded post-init.

surprises.title: Multilingual embedding is default; English-only is opt-down
surprises.detail: onboarding._ask_embedding_model (line 88) defaults to 'embeddinggemma' (300 MB multilingual) because cross-lingual cosine similarity under English-only MiniLM collapses to ~0.35 (essentially random). Non-English content silently breaks under MiniLM, so multilingual is the safe default even though it costs 10x more disk.

surprises.title: Wake-up context is best-effort, never blocks
surprises.detail: stack.wake_up() gracefully degrades when palace doesn't exist, is empty, or ChromaDB read fails (layers.py:96–97, 122). Missing palace returns 'No palace found' message. This ensures the CLI command never crashes even in degraded states — the AI gets some guidance or learns there's nothing in the palace.

designDecisions.decision: Tier 2 LLM extracts platform & persona names only; heuristic owns AI-dialogue classification
designDecisions.rationale: A weak local LLM (Ollama gemma4:e4b) can hallucinate platform/persona but its answer on 'is this AI-dialogue?' conflicts with a confident heuristic. PR #1211 review settled on: LLM as specialist (extracts what it's pre-trained on: Claude vs. ChatGPT), heuristic as conservative gate (regex marks are hard signals). Avoids false-negatives (downstream entity detection breaks if misclassified).

designDecisions.decision: Idempotent init via artifact filtering, not checksum/mtime guards
designDecisions.rationale: Simpler and more robust than tracking what was written. By skipping mempalace's own files from corpus-origin sampling (line 74–81), the heuristic sees the same inputs on re-run, producing the same output. Works across machines, containers, and git clones without state files.

Non-English content stored under English-only MiniLM fails silently — cosine similarity collapses to ~0.35. Multilingual (embeddinggemma) costs 10x disk but guarantees cross-lingual recall works. Opt-down (--minilm) is available for users on slow links or who truly only store English. Safe default beats fast default.

designDecisions.decision: Wake-up injects L0+L1 as fixed ~600–900 tokens, never variable
designDecisions.rationale: Predictable context cost so users know exactly how many tokens are burned before the first AI response. L1 truncates hard at MAX_CHARS=3200 (line 84) so even a palace with 10k drawers won't exceed budget. Leaves 95%+ of context free for user-provided content.

designDecisions.decision: Pass 0 is non-fatal; LLM failures fall back to heuristics silently
designDecisions.rationale: Init must work offline and in CI without external API. LLM tier is always optional (best-effort, line 142). Users see a one-line message if LLM is missing; they never see 'init blocked waiting for API'. Mirrors the no-API-key-required promise of the entire system.

related.why: cmd_init calls discover_entities and passes corpus_origin context to resolve ambiguous names; onboarding seeds the entity registry before mining.
cmd_search dispatcher calls searcher.search(); instructions/search.md guides agents through MCP tools and CLI fallback; Layer 3 wraps semantic search logic.
cmd_mine routes to project/convo/extract miners; onboarding is a prerequisite to mining; post-init mine prompt removes friction from the init→mine workflow.
cmd_init calls get_provider and detect_origin_llm for optional Tier 2 LLM refinement; onboarding persists embedding model choice; consent gate for external APIs.
cmd_hook routes to hooks_cli.run_hook for session-start/stop/precompact logic; these hooks auto-save memories and block before context compaction.
cmd_repair, cmd_repair_status, cmd_sync, cmd_migrate provide repair tooling; non-fatal mine errors surface SQLite integrity instructions via repair.print_sqlite_integrity_abort.

searchDoc.title: CLI & Onboarding
searchDoc.summary: MemPalace's CLI dispatches 14 primary commands and onboarding guides first-time users through mode, entity, and embedding-model choices before mining begins.
searchDoc.body: MemPalace's CLI in cli.py dispatches fourteen primary commands including init, mine, search, wake-up, status, repair, and maintenance tooling, while onboarding.py guides first-time users through interactive setup. The init command, cmd_init at cli.py line 230, orchestrates a four-pass setup. Pass 0, run by _run_pass_zero at line 106, detects whether a corpus is AI-dialogue versus code or docs using a two-tier system. Tier 1 always runs cheap regex heuristics with no API call via detect_origin_heuristic. Tier 2 optionally runs an LLM refinement via detect_origin_llm to extract platform, user name, and agent persona names, but it critically does not override the heuristic's likely_ai_dialogue and confidence fields. This protects against weak local models like Ollama gemma4:e4b flipping a confident regex answer, a decision settled in the PR 1211 review. The result is persisted to origin.json with evidence trails prefixed Tier-1 heuristic or Tier-2 LLM. Pass 1 calls discover_entities to scan manifests, git authors, and prose. Pass 2 calls detect_rooms_local to infer room structure from folders. Pass 3 protects per-project files from accidental git commits. Init is idempotent because _gather_origin_samples skips mempalace's own artifacts, entities.json and mempalace.yaml, so re-runs do not drift in classification density. Pass 0 samples are capped at 30 files, 100 KB per file, and 5 MB total, with Tier 2 LLM samples trimmed to 2 KB each and 20 max. The mine dispatcher cmd_mine at line 489 routes to three miners based on the mode flag: projects for code and docs, convos for Claude, ChatGPT, and Slack transcripts with optional auto-classification, and extract for PDF, DOCX, XLSX, and PPTX office documents. Wake-up, cmd_wakeup at line 712, instantiates a MemoryStack and concatenates Layer 0 identity with Layer 1, the top 15 importance-scored drawers, totaling roughly 600 to 900 tokens, with hard truncation at MAX_CHARS 3200. Onboarding, run_onboarding at onboarding.py line 390, prompts for mode, embedding model, people, and projects, defaulting to the multilingual embeddinggemma model because English-only MiniLM collapses cross-lingual cosine similarity to about 0.35. It generates AAAK bootstrap and critical-facts files. The instructions CLI exposes five markdown instruction files consumed by the skill harness. Every LLM step is best-effort and never blocks setup, preserving the offline, no-API-key-required promise.
